evidence.text: Optiscan Vision Analytics builds computer vision software that detects surface defects on production lines in real time. Our inspection models run on GPU servers installed directly on the factory floor, because most of our customers do not allow production images to leave the plant.

Optiscan Inspect is our defect-detection software for metal and plastic parts. Optiscan Inspect is licensed per production line with an annual subscription. Today customers must source and certify their own GPU hardware, which adds eight to twelve weeks to every deployment.
Founded in 2016, Optiscan Vision Analytics is headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, and serves automotive suppliers and packaging manufacturers across Europe. The company employs 140 people.
